title: BID → Analysis
text: This tool turns burst selections (BID files: first and last photon index of each burst) into burst tables, using the TTTR file with the same stem. The next step loads a ready example so you can watch one conversion end to end.

title: Load the example
text: Press Load example. It writes a simulated photon stream with six known bursts and its BID selection, adds the stream to the Datasets workspace and queues it. Your own measurements come from the workspace: pick their photon streams in the Input section -- the BID selection with the same stem beside each one is queued with it.

title: Choose outputs
text: Process imports every selection into its measurement's container in the project: the original BID file and the burst table derived from it, with provenance. The detector setup on the left decides the per-detector columns.

title: Convert
text: Press Process. Each queued selection is converted with its TTTR file and the current detector setup.

title: Read the result
text: The status line counts converted files and the imported bursts appear under the photon stream in the Datasets workspace. The example gives six bursts, each with last minus first plus one photons from its BID row.
